description: Registry of every KICD curriculum design and KLB/approved textbook this series is grounded in, mapped to the two national exam tiers (KJSEA, KCBE). Nothing may be drafted against a source that is not registered here, and nothing registered as 'unverified' may be cited in learner-facing print.

status_values.verified: Metadata confirmed directly against the primary document (PDF inspected). ISBN/edition confirmed from the document itself. Safe to ground content on.
status_values.provisional: Reported by credible secondary sources but NOT yet confirmed against a primary KNEC/KICD document. Usable for planning, never for learner-facing claims.
status_values.unverified: Placeholder. Title, ISBN or edition is UNKNOWN. Do not draft against this entry until fields are filled.
status_values.superseded: Replaced by a newer edition. Retained for traceability; do not draft against it.
status_values.rejected: Considered and rejected (off-syllabus, outdated, or not KICD-approved). Retained so we do not re-evaluate it.

source_types.kicd_curriculum_design: Official KICD curriculum design — the authority for strands, sub-strands, learning outcomes and lesson counts.
source_types.knec_assessment_framework: KNEC framework/regulations — the authority for paper structure, weighting and grading bands.
source_types.approved_textbook: A KICD-approved textbook (KLB or other approved publisher). Used for concept treatment and exam phrasing, NEVER as the authority for syllabus scope.
source_types.knec_timetable: Published examination timetable — the authority for paper codes and scheduling.
source_types.internal: Produced by this project (rubrics, mappings, repair ladders).

rules: KICD curriculum designs outrank textbooks. If a KLB book and a KICD design disagree, the design wins — always.
Nothing is drafted against a source whose status is 'unverified'. Fill the metadata first.
Every source entry must record edition_year. KICD rationalises designs yearly; an undated source is not a source.
Never invent an ISBN. If you cannot confirm it from the document itself, set isbn to null and status to 'unverified'.
When KICD publishes a revision, mark the old entry 'superseded', add the new entry, then re-run core_directives/KICD_CHECKLIST.md section 9 on every affected strand map.
Paper codes and timetables are re-issued yearly. Re-verify the current cycle before any revision content goes to print.
ISBNs and source URLs live in this file only. Do not scatter them through lesson files.

sources.title: CBE achievement levels — 8 levels across 4 bands (EE/ME/AE/BE) with point scores
sources.verified_from: secondary sources, mutually consistent — NOT confirmed against a primary KNEC document
sources.notes: Band boundaries recorded: EE2 90-100 (8 pts), EE1 75-89 (7), ME1 58-74 (6), ME2 41-57 (5), AE1 31-40 (4), AE2 21-30 (3), BE1 11-20 (2), BE2 1-10 (1). The 41% AE/ME boundary is the single most important number in our positioning. Confirm from a primary source before print.
